description: Check a Brazilian company (CNPJ) before paying it: registration status at Receita Federal, company age and registered name. Does not compare the payee (the paid door does). Returns signals with their sources and lists what was not checked; it does not assert fraud. Website checks are not active in this version. Confere empresa (CNPJ) antes de um pagamento. Free, rate-limited.

cnpj.description: CNPJ of the Brazilian company, with or without punctuation (the alphanumeric format is accepted). CNPJ da empresa, com ou sem pontuação.

name: conferir_empresa

cnpj_consultado.description: The CNPJ that was looked up, formatted. CNPJ consultado.

conferido.description: What this lookup checked. O que foi conferido.

empresa.description: Public registry data of the company, present when the CNPJ was found.

razao_social.description: Registered legal name. Razão social no cadastro.

leitura.description: One sentence in Portuguese: the reading, what was checked and what was not. Pass it on. Uma frase com o alcance da conferência.

limites.description: General limits of this check. Limites gerais desta checagem.

nao_conferido.description: What this lookup did NOT check, and why. Tell the person. O que não foi conferido.

recebedor.description: Comparison of the payee the bank shows with the registry. 'confere' does not prove who owns the account. Comparação do recebedor.

situacao.description: confere = what was given matches the registry; diverge = it does not; inconclusivo = cannot tell (for instance a payment intermediary); nao_informado = nothing was given; nao_comparado = this door does not compare.

titular_do_documento.description: When the payee document is another company's CNPJ: who it belongs to.

resumo.description: Reading of what WAS checked: no alerts in the items checked, caution, alert, or not enough to check. A clean value never covers the items in `nao_conferido`. Leitura do que foi conferido.

fato.description: What was found, in Portuguese. O que foi encontrado.

fonte.description: Where it came from. De onde veio.

title: Conferir empresa brasileira
